articleTitle: 4 Hip Stretches That Actually Improve Cross-Legged Sitting
imageHeadline: Can't sit cross-legged? Your hips need these 4 stretches
imageSubtext: Target the muscle groups that actually restrict hip rotation and range
pinTitle: 4 Hip Stretches That Actually Improve Cross-Legged Sitting | Evidence-Based Guide
pinDescription: Limited hip mobility comes from tight hip flexors, adductors, and external rotators—not just general inflexibility. These four stretches target the real restrictions: butterfly, 90/90, low lunge, and pigeon pose. Learn what to stretch, how long to hold, and how often for real improvement.

items.label: Butterfly stretch for inner thighs & rotation
Low lunge for tight hip flexors
Pigeon pose for glutes & deep rotators
